design_reference: spec/*.json archives the original 0.1 proposal; not a claim of complete implementation or formal acceptance
platform: Linux CPU only; tested on cpu-hqsb x86_64

entry_points.run: Python prepared-UTF8 and structured-metadata input, real stock-library adapters
entry_points.native_run: native NanoLog and null diagnostics; separate track
entry_points.service_run: real OTAP engine over OTLP HTTP, independent materializing fsync sink; separate track
entry_points.reproduce_moobench: unmodified upstream Python recursive SuT with off/no-export/local-Zipkin-receiver configurations
entry_points.diagnose: HQSB policy, mutation, lifecycle, corruption and process-crash probes
entry_points.native_contracts: real C ABI buffer lifetime, UTF-8 and 64-bit round-trip probes
entry_points.multiprocess_run: independent captures, fixed total CPU affinity; not shared-collector IPC

common_input: run UUID, producer ID, source sequence, monotonic scheduled timestamp and body; canonical logical size=64+UTF8 canonical body bytes

resource_profile.name: CPU4-affinity-v1
resource_profile.limitations: not exclusive physical cores, not a cgroup resident-byte quota, and not the original design's exact owned-buffer budgets; native and service guards differ and are separate tracks

stock_configurations.hqsb: original writer, queue 256 records; CORE capture lifetime budget enlarged; JSONL, 8MiB chunks, hash/fsync/manifest behavior retained
stock_configurations.nanolog: upstream C++17 runtime, 1MiB staging per producer, 64MiB output buffer, blocking frontend, O_DSYNC plus explicit sync/fsync; adapter does not split oversized logical records
stock_configurations.hindsight: original C client/agent API, 8192x4096B shared pool, benchmark full-stream file sink; not the Go distributed trigger/collector system
stock_configurations.otel: real SDK 1.45.1 BatchSpanProcessor, queue 256, export batch 64, 10ms schedule delay, benchmark file exporter with close fsync; not OTAP
stock_configurations.otap: pinned df_engine 0.61.0, release opt3, no default features, otlp+otap+crypto-ring; HTTP pipeline uses OTLP-byte forwarding, not an Arrow conversion claim

pacing.cooperative: Python sleep yields GIL while ahead; scheduled arrivals remain fixed during catch-up
pacing.hybrid_spin: sleep only for >100us lead, then spin; an explicit CPU/GIL contention stress condition
pacing.calibration: null uses the same source, plan, body and receipt bookkeeping; inspect attempted coverage and dispatch lag, not just mean input rate
pacing.sampling: separate throughput and latency passes; SplitMix64 identity selection; sample_every in 1,4,16,64,1024
pacing.burst: integer rational pulse schedule; legacy screening-v5 used approximate floating-point pulse boundaries and is not evidence of exact pulse fidelity

timing.screening: 10s offered window, 100 warmup events +0.2s, 3 independent processes, separately measured throughput/latency; shorter CPU pilot than original 30s design screening
timing.formal_option: 60s offered, 10s warmup, 10 processes; only if selected, sample support and resource/capacity conditions still require validation
timing.endpoints: common D2-close file fsync, optional stock HQSB publication within reader limits; service has actual per-batch sink completion timestamps
timing.not_invented: no stock per-event ready/fsync timestamp, no exact queue residence/owned bytes, no maximum sustainable capacity inferred from one point

data_integrity: full deterministic output verification, identities/duplicates/order/field types/body; failures retained; Q0 public reader/publish bounds remain unchanged
not_claimed: W08 static callsite dictionary registration (current metadata cardinality is body data)
real GPU/model interference or D2H source
7200s or high-rate 300s runs exceeding receipt/disk budget
paper headline speed reproduction or a cross-track overall ranking
reporting: all runs + block summaries/95% exploratory bootstrap CI; delivery rate alongside latency; resource Pareto, no composite score; unavailable metrics carry reasons
